methods.label: Fit the intercept form and evaluate on the axis
methods.explanation: Let $y=a(x-1)(x-5)$. Substituting $(0,-5)$ gives $5a=-5$, so $a=-1$. The axis of symmetry is $x=3$, and $y=-(3-1)(3-5)=4$. The y-coordinate of the vertex is 4.
